title: Metric Markov cotype of ℓ₁
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: OpenAI's answer (2026) to a question of Mendel and Naor: the space l1 has metric Markov cotype two, with constant at most 12 sqrt(21), for every stationary Markov chain. The first lesson sets up finite Markov chains, the definition, and a comparison between geometric and uniform averages of time in any metric space. The second writes finite subsets of l1 through weighted cuts with a contractive reconstruction map, and proves a flatness inequality for the cubic 3r^2 - 2r^3 summed along harmonic functions of a chain. The third builds the new points from a killed random walk, proves the theorem, shows that the new points are expected medians of three stopped-walk endpoints, and treats complex scalars.
